body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented a series of ‘Simpsons Movie Collectible Mobile Phone’, its limited edition during CES 2007. It will also come pre-loaded with exclusive The Simpsons Movie content and it will be available in June or July in USA market by the time the Simpsons family will be playing in the cinema.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Nikki Hwang, Daniel Seo >
